references.text: Tola from Issachar judged Israel after Abimelech, a similar introduction of a minor judge like Abdon.
Jair from Gilead judged Israel for twenty-two years, another minor judge with a description similar to Abdon.
Ibzan from Bethlehem judged Israel, a judge mentioned just before Abdon with similar wording.
Elon from Zebulun judged Israel for ten years, the judge who came right before Abdon.
The continuation of the account about Abdon, telling of his sons and his death.
Shamgar son of Anath also judged Israel - another minor judge with a brief mention.
